description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseRepository' for database operations within the Goteo project's repository layer. It includes methods for initializing database connections, executing SQL queries, and retrieving last inserted IDs.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: An abstract class providing core database repository functionalities, including connection management, query execution, and ID retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection and cacher based on configuration settings.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Prepares and executes an SQL query with optional parameters and replica selection.

methods.name: insertId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID from the database, handling exceptions gracefully.
